title: Juicy Briny Turkish Sausages Menemen
description: A light Turkish dish featuring German sausages, served in a tandoor clay pot, perfect for a snack or lunch

ingredients.name: German sausages
ingredients.notes: preferably with a high meat content

instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot over medium heat
Add the olive oil and cook the sliced onions until they are translucent
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook until they are tender
Add the diced tomatoes and cook until they start to break down
Add the German sausages and cook until they are browned on all sides
Add the beaten eggs and stir gently to combine with the vegetables and sausages
Add the crumbly feta cheese and stir gently to combine
Season with salt, black pepper, and paprika to taste
Cover the tandoor clay pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes
Serve the menemen hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired
